LESSON: CHANGE OF STATE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: MATTER
Topic 2.1: Change of State

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Change of State. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How is change of state of matter important in day-to-day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the changes of state when substances are heated or cooled
2. describe the applications of the change of state of matter in everyday life
3. appreciate the applications of change of state of matter in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: CHANGE OF STATE
This lesson teaches Change of State for Grade 6 SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the changes of state when substances are heated or cooled
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe the applications of the change of state of matter in everyday life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the applications of change of state of matter in day-to-day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Change of State using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Change of State above.
2. Explain Change of State to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Change of State.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Change of State with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Change of State important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is change of state of matter important in day-to-day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the changes of state when substances are heated or cooled
2. describe the applications of the change of state of matter in everyday life
3. appreciate the applications of change of state of matter in day-to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
